summary: Strengthens the pre-existing conditional-cap falsifier: even with an independent cap-one hub scalar, a residual triple of joint density cap one whose every coordinate 1D and coordinate-pair 2D marginal is also cap one, and a four-variable quadratic matrix having three eigenvalues of absolute value at least one, the pushforward can have logarithmically unbounded density. Construction uses a reciprocal quadratic shear T=sqrt(c)U-sqrt(c)Z^2/(2Y), which straightens 2 c^{-1/2}(sqrt(c)X+T)Y+Z^2 to 2Y(X+U). Not a QFORM counterexample because the residual triple is not shown to be a simultaneous linear projection of an original-coordinate product law. The missing factor is the simultaneous linear-product provenance inside the two-sheet curved trace, beyond generic coordinate marginal caps or X-ray information.
